name: USB
description: USB is a Wikipedia-derived unified summarization benchmark that supports 8 interrelated tasks including extractive and abstractive summarization, topic-based summarization, factual accuracy prediction, and error correction. It includes rich crowd-sourced annotations across 6 domains to facilitate cross-domain analysis.
reputation: USB has been adopted in summarization research as a broad multi-task benchmark for evaluating both content selection and factuality across domains.
notes: Supports multiple summarization and factuality-related tasks; includes data from 6 domains; shows importance of training data quantity and domain specificity.
